Subject: Re: Budget Increase Request

Dear [Recipient's Name],

Thank you for your feedback regarding our recent budget increase request. We understand that the initial justification did not fully align with the company’s current financial strategy, and we appreciate the opportunity to refine our proposal.

We are committed to ensuring that our department’s needs are met in a way that supports the broader organizational goals. To that end, we will prepare a revised submission that includes a more detailed explanation of our requirements, along with concrete examples of the anticipated benefits to the company.

Please let us know if there are specific areas or metrics you would like us to focus on in the resubmission. We aim to have the updated proposal ready for your review by [insert date].

Thank you for your guidance and support.

Best regards,

[Your Name]
[Your Job Title]
